query:
INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id, token_hash, user_agent, ip, created_at, last_seen_at,
                               expires_at, absolute_expires_at)
         SELECT $1, u.id, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9
         FROM users u
         WHERE u.id = $2 AND u.password_hash = $10 AND u.disabled_at IS NULL
         FOR SHARE
